value.rationale: The two-cycle was already understood qualitatively, but there is a natural distinct question: which parity phase does an uncertain initial condition select? The uniform phase weight changes sharply with the right plateau and exhibits a parameter-dependent 1/3-to-2/3 selection range, while centered perturbation intervals are exactly unbiased for every radius. The full finite-time law and sharp total-variation rate add an exact ensemble-level invariant beyond orbit existence or a routine single trajectory computation.
